caption: The drawing depicts a metal object consisting of two main components: a horizontal bar with a hook at each end and a vertical bar hanging from a central ring attached to the horizontal bar. The horizontal bar is decorated with a repeated diagonal cross pattern and appears to be a reddish-brown color, suggesting it is made of rusted or aged metal. The vertical bar is also metallic and has a slightly irregular shape, with a loop or hook at its lower end. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional items or decoration. The artist's signature, "Geoffrey Holt," is in the bottom right corner.
title: Hasp
